tools.name: finance_status
tools.description: Check MoneyCraft status and quantitative modules

tools.name: finance_list_data_sources
tools.description: List all switchable real and simulated market data sources, latency delays, and Exchange Payola tiers

tools.name: finance_ticker
tools.description: Fetch real-time or delayed candlestick bars and volume for ticker symbol from selected source

tools.name: finance_audit_contract
tools.description: Audit EVM smart contract for honeypots, hidden taxes, and backdoors

tools.name: finance_backtest
tools.description: Run Monte Carlo event-driven algorithmic strategy backtest

tools.name: finance_portfolio
tools.description: Real personal ledger valuation: FIFO holdings, live prices, unrealized PnL, realized YTD, Austrian KESt estimate. Empty ledger yields empty portfolio, never demo numbers.

tools.name: finance_universe
tools.description: List every queryable symbol (indices, stocks, forex, crypto, historic) plus the 20 major currencies. Start here to discover valid tickers.

tools.name: finance_fx_convert
tools.description: Offline FX math: convert an amount between major currencies via USD anchor. Indicative synthetic rate, not a tradable quote.

tools.name: finance_brokers
tools.description: List compiled broker venues, risk limits, and whether any live venue is armed. Paper only until a live adapter ships.

tools.name: finance_broker_place
tools.description: Place an order through a broker venue. Only 'paper' exists: validates against venue limits, fills against the synthetic reference price or dry-runs. Unknown venues are refused. No real funds anywhere.

tools.name: finance_historic_panics
tools.description: List all 19 major historical financial crises and market panics from 1720 South Sea Bubble to modern day

tools.name: finance_historic_instruments
tools.description: List historical London Exchange Alley sovereign papers and equities (EIC, Consols, South Sea)

tools.name: finance_simulate_personal_wealth
tools.description: Simulate beginner personal wealth compounding across checking, festgeld, and bausparer vs true inflation erosion

tools.name: finance_compare
tools.description: Fetch normalized percentage-return overlays for several symbols at once (multi-asset compare workspace)

tools.name: finance_derivatives
tools.description: Fetch crypto derivatives intel: funding rates and liquidation heatmap (illustrative venue data, not live tradable quotes)

tools.name: finance_news
tools.description: Print the breaking-news wire headlines with sentiment tags

tools.name: finance_ai_workflow
tools.description: Run an agentic quant workflow: STRATEGY_GEN, STRESS_TEST, SENTIMENT_ALPHA or EXECUTION_ROUTER. Illustrative templates only  -  EXECUTION_ROUTER plans, never executes.

tools.name: finance_paper_account
tools.description: Show the fantasy paper-trading account: demo positions, margin, PnL. No real funds, no real orders.

tools.name: finance_paper_open
tools.description: Open a fantasy paper position, 1x-50x leverage. Sandbox only  -  never a real order, nothing leaves this machine.

tools.name: finance_paper_close
tools.description: Close a fantasy paper position by id. Stateless demo close  -  no ledger, no real funds moved.

tools.name: finance_paper_reset
tools.description: Reset the fantasy bankroll (default $100,000). Sandbox only.

tools.name: finance_place_order
tools.description: Attempt a live order. Always refuses: live routing is not implemented, MoneyCraft is paper-trading only. Use finance_paper_open for the fantasy desk.

tools.name: finance_ledger_add
tools.description: Book a real holding into the personal ledger (stocks, ETFs, bonds, cash). Crypto is refused  -  it belongs in the fantasy desk.

tools.name: finance_ledger_holdings
tools.description: FIFO holdings with cost basis per symbol (no market prices  -  see finance_ledger_valuation).

tools.name: finance_ledger_transactions
tools.description: Raw ledger bookings, newest first, with optional symbol filter.

tools.name: finance_ledger_import
tools.description: Import a broker/bank CSV export (semicolon/comma, UTF-8/cp1252, German or English headers). Reports imported + skipped rows.

tools.name: finance_ledger_valuation
tools.description: Full valuation: live prices, unrealized PnL, realized YTD, Austrian KESt estimate (27.5%, estimate only, not tax advice).
